import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with two subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Scatter plot: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep colored by Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(ax=axes[0], x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Stress Level', 
                size='Physical Activity Level', sizes=(40, 200), alpha=0.7, data=df)
axes[0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress & Activity')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
axes[0].legend(title='Stress Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Box plot: Sleep Duration distribution across BMI categories
sns.boxplot(ax=axes[1], x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='viridis')
axes[1].set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category')
axes[1].set_xlabel('BMI Category')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
